action_instruction: Reading the items from the order summary
intent: the item names, quantities, and line totals shown in the order summary

action_params.condition: the order summary shows the same items as {{baseline_cart_items}}
action_params.query: the item names, quantities, and line totals shown in the order summary
action_params.code_js: (()=>{const t=el(8)?.innerText||''; const re=/(Trail Runner Sneakers|Insulated Steel Bottle)\s+\$([0-9]+\.[0-9]{2})\s+Qty:\s*(\d+)\s+\$([0-9]+\.[0-9]{2})/g; const out=[]; for (const m of t.matchAll(re)) out.push({name:m[1],quantity:Number(m[3]),line_total:`$${m[4]}`}); return JSON.stringify(out);})()

assertion_tree.description: the order summary shows the same items as {{baseline_cart_items}}

sub_results.description: the order summary shows the same items as {{baseline_cart_items}}

assertion_tree.verification: Look for the order summary and verify it shows the same items as {{baseline_cart_items}}
